context: Interactive crossfilter dashboard — three linked histograms (departure hour, delay, distance) that filter each other on brush selection
first_impression: Clean and functional with a cohesive muted-blue palette and ghost-bar crossfilter pattern, but three visually identical panels and no typographic differentiation keep it in competent rather than designed territory.
what_works: Ghost bars (light gray background behind blue foreground) make filtering state immediately legible — a real crossfilter convention executed well. The monospace counter with blue-highlighted count and use of #4477AA instead of a default color show deliberate palette choices.
what_doesnt: All three panels are structurally and visually identical — no weight, color, or layout variation to create hierarchy or help orient the viewer across dimensions. Ghost bars (#e0e0e0) barely register against the #fafafa background, softening the contrast that makes the filtered vs. total comparison legible.
